en.headline: Frieren anime exhibition to open at Mong Kok INCUBASE Arena on 24 November
en.dek: The official Beyond Journey's End exhibition runs until 3 January at Chong Hing Square basement, with early-bird tickets on sale until 23 November.
body: The official Frieren: Beyond Journey's End exhibition will open in Hong Kong on 24 November at INCUBASE Arena in the basement of Chong Hing Square, Mong Kok.

Organisers said the show, running until 3 January 2027, focuses on the first season of the anime and features five themed areas recreating scenes from the journey, along with life-size displays and recreations of the main characters' weapons for photo opportunities.

Early-bird tickets are available until 23 November, with pair tickets priced at HK$218 and special privilege tickets at HK$198. Regular admission is from noon to 10pm on weekdays and 11am to 10pm on weekends and public holidays, with last entry at 9pm. The venue is at 601 Nathan Road.
Tickets can be purchased through the organisers' designated platforms.

zh.headline: 《葬送的芙莉蓮》特展11月24日起於旺角創興廣場舉行
zh.dek: 官方動畫展於創興廣場地庫INCUBASE Arena展出至明年1月3日，早鳥票售至11月23日。
body: 《葬送的芙莉蓮》官方特展將於11月24日起在旺角彌敦道601號創興廣場地庫INCUBASE Arena舉行。
主辦單位表示，展覽以動畫第一季為主軸，設五大主題展區重現勇者一行旅程的場面，並有角色等身展示及主要角色武器重現，供觀眾拍照。
早鳥售票期至11月23日，雙人票港幣218元，特典票港幣198元。展期平日中午12時至晚上10時開放，周末及公眾假期上午11時至晚上10時，最後入場時間為晚上9時。
門票可經主辦單位指定平台購買。展覽由Trendic正式授權。
